items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Did you know him, Jack the Bear? Oh sure. And I got the job.

ctx.x: I went in and did an audition and I had...let's see, who'd I have when I auditioned...Tim Kennedy, who was in the Vanguard the other night. I had John Acee, Billy Taylor, Jr., and that was it. And we did the audition. Jack the Bear Parker had the band there before. And I did the audition...
Did you know him, Jack the Bear?
Oh sure. And I got the job.
